tool_reviews.name: CCC (Claude Command Center)
tool_reviews.price: Free: USD 0, with no tiers, no paid plan, no seat count and no account for the local app. Licensed FSL-1.1-MIT (copyright 2026 Amir Fish), which is source-available rather than OSI open source: you may use, copy, modify and redistribute it for any Permitted Purpose, a Competing Use is barred, and each version converts to the MIT license on its second anniversary. Downloads are a 3.6 MB notarized and Apple-signed DMG, a Homebrew tap (amirfish1/tap/ccc), a curl installer for macOS/Linux and a PowerShell installer for Windows. The optional CCC Cloud phone relay is account-based; no price appears for it on any fetched page either. No page on the site carries a price token other than $0.

tool_reviews.price: One-time credit packs, no subscription: 10 credits USD 2.99, 30 credits USD 6.99 and 100 credits USD 14.99, each card showing a struck-through list price of USD 4.99 / 9.99 / 24.99. tool_reviews.name: Genjutsu AI
tool_reviews.price: Free tier: 18 one-time signup credits, watermarked previews and downloads, roughly 3 images or 1 short clip, plus a weekly check-in worth up to 60 credits across the reward cycle. Subscriptions billed monthly: Starter $29.9 for 800 credits/month, Pro $49.9 for 1,800, Business $99.9 for 4,000. Billed yearly (the price printed on the card): Starter $100.0 a year, shown as $8.3/month, 2,400 credits/year; Pro $360.0 a year, shown as $30.0/month against a struck-through $49.9, 21,600 credits/year; Business $599.0 a year, shown as $49.9/month against a struck-through $99.9, 48,000 credits/year. One-time packs under the Pay once tab, credits never expire: Flex $99 for 2,000 credits, Starter Pack $199.9 for 4,900, Pro Pack $499.9 for 19,900. Subscription credits expire each period; card prices are USD before tax. Refund requests within 72 hours, calculated pro rata on unused purchased credits minus actual non-returned processing fees capped at 6% of the order. Read on 2026-10-26 from the rendered /pricing page on all three tabs; the plan figures are not literals in the served HTML, so they were captured from the rendered page rather than a price-token sweep.

tool_reviews.name: RapVideo AI
tool_reviews.price: Free preview: some new accounts are offered one short low-resolution preview at the vendor's discretion (no card, no trial on paid plans). Monthly plans, credits reset each month and unused credits expire: Basic $29.90/mo (100 credits, shown on the card as 8 videos), Pro $49.90/mo (200 credits, 16 videos), Agency $99.90/mo (480 credits, 40 videos). Yearly plans renew automatically and are badged 'up to 44% off', but only the Basic yearly figure is in the served HTML ($299/yr for 120 videos, about 17% below monthly); Pro and Agency yearly prices need JavaScript. One-time packs, credits never expire: Single $9.99 (12 credits, 1 video), Trio $19.99 (36 credits, 3 videos), Crew $49 (120 credits, 10 videos), Studio $99 (300 credits, 25 videos), Label $199 (720 credits, 60 videos). A standard 12-second 720p render costs 10 credits; faster Seedance 2.0 tiers cost 8-20 and Seedance 2.5 Ultra up to 93 at 1080p. Failed, timed-out or safety-blocked renders are refunded automatically. USD, charged by Stripe.

tool_reviews.name: CustomGPT.ai
tool_reviews.price: Standard $99/month or $89/month billed annually (10 agents, 1,000 queries/month, 5,000 documents per agent, 60 million words, 3 seats). Premium $499/month or $449/month billed annually (25 agents, 5,000 queries/month, 20,000 documents per agent, 300 million words, 5 seats, auto-sync, branding removal). Enterprise custom. Every published plan starts with a 7-day trial that requires a credit card and then charges the selected plan. Checked 2026-10-27.

tool_reviews.name: UMEVO
tool_reviews.price: Hardware, one-time purchase in USD from UMEVO's own Shopify store: Note $79 (64GB), Note Plus $109 on sale against a $169 list price (badged '35% off' on a Fall Sale banner whose countdown renders 00:00:00 and states no end date), Note ONE $159 on sale against $179, magnetic case $20, 3-in-1 accessory kit $20, plus a $5 shipping line item. AI minutes depend on which model you buy. Note Plus: Max plan free for year one (unlimited transcription under fair-use terms), then the free Starter plan at 400 transcription minutes a month; from year two that page offers 'Pro $2.50/mo or Max $5.83/mo, billed annually' and minute packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $0.59/$2.59/$10.99/$19.99. Note ONE: 30,000 transcription minutes a month for the first 3 months after activation, then free Starter at 400/month, with Pro $7.99/mo or $69.99/yr (1,800 min/mo), MAX $19.99/mo or $149.99/yr (unlimited) and packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $2.49/$9.49/$44.99/$79.99. The two product pages' ladders do not agree with each other. Minute packs are valid for 2 years; plan minutes reset monthly and free minutes do not carry over. Note ($79) includes no AI plan at all - recording works, transcription follows the companion app's free Starter tier or a paid upgrade. Language count is plan-gated on the Note ONE table: 114 languages on Starter and Pro, 140+ on MAX.
